speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Stand. The oak along here has begun to silver, where they rebuilt last year. You may have that for nothing. It is not why we stopped.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We stopped because the back said stop, and I was going to call that kindness.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: In April I asked you a thing at Shottery.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Whether London is where I work or where I live.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You said both, which is neither.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I work there. I don't live there. I've known it since Aylesbury.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Here. In a house with my name on the deed and not my father's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Anne. It's the second-largest house in the town.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: It's falling down. It'll come the cheaper. I've passed it every market day these thirteen years, and I know what I'd do with that garden.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I'll give you till I believe you.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: No. Three years is what a man offers when he wants the asking to be over. You have looked now. You kept Friday, and I have not told you a sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I don't know whose it is. I am not going to know today.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. Home. Slower than we came. The stick on the side I put it.
